title: feat(plugin-detail,types,cli): record blocks honour the per-element dataSource binding (objectui#12294)
body:
Refs #12294 (record:details, record:highlights, record:quick_actions; the record:related_list half is carved out, see the claim)
Clause-②: yes (widening)
What widens: the three record-block registrations publish the injected `dataSource` input, and `@object-ui/types` declares `dataSource` on their three strict-authoring-face arms (the spec's `ElementDataSourceSchema`, by reference), so a binding both the html tier and `objectui validate` refused before is now accepted on these three blocks.

## What this does

Maintainer ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#2839 Q1, option D, as the card quotes it: close the real gap. `record:details`, `record:highlights` and `record:quick_actions` now honour the per-element `dataSource` binding the spec already declares on every page component, so a product `app` page composes a record's surfaces from blocks, with no record shell to switch off.

- **One shared wrapper, no second rendering path.** `recordBindingBlock` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordBinding.tsx`) wraps each block body in `ElementDataSourceGate` (the binding resolves exactly as on every bound block: named `view`, AND-combined `filter`, `sort`, the family's configuration panels) and a one-record scope, and passes the result through the `elementDataSourceBlock` seam from `@object-ui/core`. The block bodies are unchanged except one guard in `record:quick_actions` (below).
- **The one-record scope** reads the bound set with the page's own adapter, so under the caller's identity: `find(object, { $filter, $orderby, $top: 1, $expand })`, with `{current_user_id}`-style tokens resolved (`useResolvedFilter`) and reference fields expanded only where the loaded field policy lets the caller read them, as the record page asks. The FIRST row is provided through the existing `RecordContextProvider` (object name, record id, readable row, object definition, adapter).
- **Semantics (the card's):** 0 rows, or a read the server refuses (`classifyLoadError` reports `forbidden`), mount the block under a context that names the object and no record, so each block draws its own no-record state: `record:details` DetailView's "record not found", `record:highlights` nothing, `record:quick_actions` its empty bar. More than one row: the first by the binding's `sort` (one row is ever asked for). A read that fails any other way is reported in the block's place with the family's data-source error panel, not drawn as an absent record.
- **`record:quick_actions`** runs the object's declared actions against the bound row's id. Its one body change: a record context that names an object but no record offers no record action (the 0-row state); the record page always names its record.
- **Freshness (objectstack#4444's bar, the seat addendum).** The read is keyed on `useDataInvalidation(object)` from `@object-ui/react` `data-invalidation.ts`, the same bus `RecordDetailView` keys its record read on. Object-scoped, because the binding is a query: a write to any row can change which row is first. A refetch replaces the row in place, and an equal answer keeps the row object it replaces (AGENTS.md #10). No second bus.
- **The record page path is unchanged.** Unbound, `BoundRecordScope` renders the body as it is: no provider, no element, no read. Bound and placed on a record page, the binding wins for that block ("Overrides the page-level object context for this block"), and the bound scope is kept out of the page record's inline-edit session (it mounts a read-only `InlineEditProvider`, so the page's Save bar can never write bound fields onto the page record) and out of the page's highlight-field registry (its own `HighlightFieldsProvider`).
- **`objectui validate` warning.** Measured: `objectui validate` runs the strict authoring face in `packages/cli` (`validateAuthoredDocument`), not `sdui-parser`'s `validateTree`. The warning lives there, once, in the success branch's `Warnings:` block (`packages/cli/src/utils/record-block-binding-hint.ts`): a bound record block whose binding has no `limit: 1` is named by path and type. `record:related_list` is never named.
- **Producer-side fix in `@object-ui/types`.** Measured at the merge base: the strict face refused `dataSource` on all three blocks (`Undeclared key "dataSource" at (root) (type "record:details")`, exit 1), so the warning above was unreachable and authors were told the one key that now works does not exist. Each arm now declares the binding by reference, as `record:line_items` does; the TypeScript authoring face (`PublicBlockNode`) follows from the arms.

## Zone 2 measurements (PM mechanism assumptions)

1. Confirmed at `45ae6b8`: the three bodies read the record only via `useRecordContext()`; none wrapped the gate or the seam.
2. Confirmed: the gate maps a binding onto a LIST block's keys and `composeElementDataSource` composes; neither reads a row. The card's `resolveElementDataSource` exists only as `ViewDataProvider.resolveElementDataSource` in `@object-ui/core`, which the render path never calls (`ListViewBlock`'s docblock records it "had no caller outside its own test"). Used path: `ElementDataSourceGate` (`useElementDataSource` + `composeElementDataSource`) with the mapping `{ filter: true, sort: true }`, plus the new one-record scope. The scope lives in `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, not in `@object-ui/react` or `@object-ui/core`: it needs `@object-ui/permissions` for the field-policy-gated `$expand` and readable row (`@object-ui/react` does not depend on it), and the whole `record:*` family lives there. No new export from any package entry.
3. The census (`check:element-data-source-declaration`) discovers by file, with no roster to edit. The shared wrapper file consumes the gate and calls the seam from core, so the static census lists `recordBinding.tsx`; that the three registrations declare the key is asserted per block in `recordBinding.appPage-12294.test.tsx` and by the live-registry probe `apps/console/src/__tests__/element-data-source-input-injection.test.tsx`. Measured: all 309 `vi.mock('@object-ui/react', …)` call sites on `main` spread the actual module, so the hand-listed-mock hazard has no live population today; this change adds no `@object-ui/react` export anyway.
4. See the `objectui validate` bullet above.
5. Byte-identical, measured once: each of the three blocks rendered under a record page's providers with no `dataSource`, `innerHTML` SHA-256 prefix at `45ae6b8`'s block files and at this branch's: details `22c708ac33a9ec77`, highlights `06f18891e29f52c7`, quick_actions `c482317ba20672b7` on both legs (scratch test, not committed; BASE files checked out over the committed implementation and restored from HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty after). The override direction is pinned in `recordBinding.recordPageAndBus-12294.test.tsx`.

## Published surface

- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: the `record:details`, `record:highlights` and `record:quick_actions` registrations gain the injected `dataSource` input (`ELEMENT_DATA_SOURCE_INPUT`, through `elementDataSourceBlock`). No new export; `recordBindingBlock` is package-internal.
- `@object-ui/types`: `RecordDetailsBlockSchema`, `RecordHighlightsBlockSchema` and `RecordQuickActionsBlockSchema` gain an optional `dataSource` member, the spec's `ElementDataSourceSchema` by reference; `PublicBlockNode` gains it on those three node types by derivation. No new export.
- `@object-ui/cli`: `objectui validate` prints one new advisory warning kind; exit codes unchanged.
- Changeset: `.changeset/12294-record-blocks-element-datasource.md`, `minor` for the three packages.

## Tests

All at `4f59ed1`, repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run`, through the shared verify lock.

- New: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/recordBinding.appPage-12294.test.tsx` (each block through the real registration and `SchemaRenderer` on an `app` page: one row, zero rows, a refused read, two rows stored out of order, a failed read, an unresolvable view, the declared input; `record:path` as the control), `recordBinding.recordPageAndBus-12294.test.tsx` (unbound reads the page record and reads nothing; bound overrides; bound details out of the page's inline-edit session; bound highlights does not trim the page's details; bus re-read after an adapter write and after a hand-announced write; no re-read for another object), `packages/cli/src/__tests__/validate-record-block-binding-limit-12294.test.ts`, `packages/types/src/__tests__/record-block-data-source-arms-12294.test.ts`.
- Ledgers updated: `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` (three `MEMBER_PINS`), `recordDetailsInputs.spec-parity` / `recordHighlightsInputs.spec-parity` (node-level spec keys, as `recordRelatedListInputs.spec-parity` already takes them), `public-block-responsive-styles-10872` (`DECLARES_DATA_SOURCE`), `zod-mirror-parity` (exclusion prose).
- Final run of the new and touched suites at `4f59ed1`: `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 642 passed (642)`.
- Package runs (same branch, before the last test-only commits): `packages/plugin-detail/` + `packages/react/src/element-data-source/` + `packages/react/src/hooks/` + `packages/core/src/data-scope/`: 312 files; `packages/types/` + `packages/cli/` + plugin-detail tests: 654 files, all green after the ledger updates above. Every suite that names `RecordDetailView`, `PagePreview` or one of the three blocks outside those packages (202 files, enumerated by `git grep`): `157 passed` (app-shell) and `45 passed` (the rest).
- Type-check (script name echoed): `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/cli`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/console` `type-check`, exit 0.

### Ablations (one-time, `ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit once, blob changed, restored to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty)

- Bus subscription removed (`useDataInvalidation(…)` replaced by `0`): the two bus pins red (`re-reads the bound row after a write through the adapter…`, `…announced on the bus by hand`), the other five green.
- Read-only inline-edit session removed: only `a bound record:details does not join the page record's inline-edit session` red.
- Highlight-registry shadow removed: only `a bound record:highlights does not trim the page record's details body` red.

### Gates

Exit 0 at `4f59ed1`: `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:sdui-registration-pins`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:eager-closure`, `check:doc-json`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`. Also exit 0 on this branch: `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-examples`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-types`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED). The build-reading gates ran over a console-closure build of this branch.

ESLint, proven narrowing: the population is `eslint.config.js`'s `**/*.{ts,tsx}` blocks; `--format json` over the 16 touched code files reports 16 files, 0 errors (70 warnings, `no-explicit-any` and `react-refresh/only-export-components`, the families these files already carry); the config sets no `parserOptions` (no type-aware linting) and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the disk, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- Each bound block reads the object definition and its row on its own, so three blocks bound to the same set make three reads; nothing dedupes them across blocks.
- `RecordDetailView` and `PagePreview` each hand-roll "fetch a record and feed `RecordContextProvider`", and this change adds a third, by-query reader with a private copy of `RecordDetailView`'s `readableRow` (module-private in `@object-ui/app-shell`, which depends on this package, not the reverse). `recordBinding.tsx` is a natural home for the one internal core objectstack#4444 calls hygiene; neither host is refactored here.
- On an `app` page a bound `record:details` is read-only: there is no record-level inline-edit host there, and the bound scope mounts a read-only session on purpose.
- `record:quick_actions`' 0-row bar says "no actions configured", the placeholder it already drew with no record context at all.

`#12294 remains open` for the `record:related_list` half, as the claim states. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`.
